sample_texts:
Reclaim your time.
Spend it touching some grass.

No icons. No colour. No feed.
Tips on the home screen show you around.
Any app, or the web search.
Three switches make Focus work. Tap one to open the right system screen, flip it, and come back.
Makes Focus the screen you land on when you press Home.
Lets Focus measure screen time: the day bar, app timers and the weekly review all depend on it.

An accessibility service that notices which app is in front, so an app can be locked the moment its time runs out. It cannot read your screen. Find “Focus app timers” under installed or downloaded apps.
Switch greyed out, or “restricted setting”? Open App info → ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, then try again.  Open App info  →
Off / Enforces the daily app time limits you set in Focus.

Focus uses this service to notice which app is in front, so it can lock an app once its daily time limit is used up. It also lets home-screen gestures open notifications or lock the screen.

The service only receives the name of the app that is on screen. It cannot read what is on your screen, and nothing ever leaves your device.
Allow Focus app timers to have full control of your device?
Full control is appropriate for apps that help you with accessibility needs, but not for most apps.
It can read all content on the screen and display content over other apps.
It can track your interactions with an app or a hardware sensor, and interact with apps on your behalf.

app_chain_summary_zh: 从Focus入口页点“Set up Focus first”进入三步强制设置，诱导开启默认桌面、Usage access及无障碍计时服务；在系统无障碍详情与“完全控制”警告页拒权后，仍被滞留在Setup必填页（TRAPPED_ON_LURE_SCREEN）。
observed_lure_rhetoric_zh: Reclaim your time. Spend it touching some grass. -> 重拾时间、去接触真实生活（入口设置页，用生活化口号弱化权限请求）
No icons. No colour. No feed. -> 无图标、无色彩、无信息流（入口页，包装极简卖点）
Tips on the home screen show you around. -> 主屏提示会带你熟悉（入口页，引导继续设置）
Three switches make Focus work. Tap one to open the right system screen, flip it, and come back. -> 三个开关才能让Focus工作，逐个去系统页打开再返回（Setup页，将关键权限包装成必要步骤）
An accessibility service... It cannot read your screen. -> 无障碍服务只识别前台应用、不能读屏（Setup页，弱化无障碍高权限风险）
Switch greyed out, or “restricted setting”? Open App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then try again. -> 若开关灰掉或受限，去应用信息右上角允许受限设置后重试（Setup页，指导绕过限制）
Use Focus app timers... only receives the name of the app... cannot read... nothing ever leaves your device. -> 只接收应用名、不读屏、数据不出设备（服务详情页，合规承诺式安抚）
Allow Focus app timers to have full control of your device? -> 允许Focus计时器完全控制设备？（系统警告弹窗，真实高风险提示）
View and control screen / View and perform actions -> 可查看并控制屏幕／可查看并代你操作（系统警告弹窗，说明无障碍权限范围）

frame_captions_zh.step_01: 入口设置/宣传页：显示Focus极简口号与滑动说明，点“Set up Focus first”开始设置向导。
frame_captions_zh.step_02: Setup必填页：三项开关分别要求默认桌面、Usage access和无障碍计时服务；本步点“Turn on”拉起系统无障碍页。
frame_captions_zh.step_03: 系统无障碍列表：DOWNLOADED APPS下“Focus app timers”为Off；探针触发HOOK_A11Y_SETTINGS后自动终止，无遮罩。
frame_captions_zh.post_jump_0.8s: 跳转后0.8秒探针：仍停留在系统无障碍设置页，界面文本为空，无通知横幅、无遮罩。
frame_captions_zh.post_jump_2.0s: 跳转后2.0秒探针：仍在系统无障碍设置页，界面无文本、无通知、无遮罩，等待后未发生跳转。
frame_captions_zh.detail_1_service_detail_page: 无障碍服务详情：展示“Use Focus app timers”开关与说明，承诺只识别前台应用名、不读屏且数据不出设备。
frame_captions_zh.detail_2_system_warning_dialog: 系统高风险警告：询问是否允许Focus计时器“完全控制设备”，列出可查看/控制屏幕与代操作，含Allow/Deny。
frame_captions_zh.refusal_2.0s: 拒权返回2秒：回Setup必填页，仍见默认桌面与Usage access两项，未离开引导页，状态TRAPPED_ON_LURE_SCREEN。
frame_captions_zh.refusal_10.5s: 拒权返回10.5秒：Setup页保持不变，仍要求完成必填开关，持续滞留于诱导页（TRAPPED_ON_LURE_SCREEN）。
